title: SkyFeed • Help
description:
👋 **WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO DO?**
Start with a task below. SkyFeed shows a quick answer first and keeps deeper details behind controls.

fields.name: 🔔 Alerts
fields.value: Use `/watch` for personal rules. Operators can configure server delivery with `/alerts`.

fields.name: 🛡️ Moderation
fields.value: Authorized moderators can warn, timeout, kick, ban, and review case history with `/moderation`. SkyFeed Admins with Manage Messages can securely delete a message by link, ID, or its context menu.

fields.name: ⚙️ Preferences
fields.value: Use `/preferences units` to choose imperial, aviation, or metric values for your own views.

fields.name: 🔧 Administration
fields.value: Use `/settings`, `/feeders`, and `/audit` for server configuration and diagnostics. Role changes also require Manage Roles.
